Enum Class MoleculeClassification

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MoleculeClassification>
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeClassification
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MoleculeClassification>, Constable
public enum MoleculeClassification extends Enum<MoleculeClassification>
Presentation grouping for molecules.

Elemental structures may contain arbitrarily many atoms of that element.
